If your expecting for super dust deputy quality you may be disappointed. Mut if your looking for something close that will separate the chip and most of the dust it great hooked it up to my HF 2hp dust collector with 2 20 foot runs of 4in pipe and 5 blast gates in my small shop. Filled 3 30 gallons drum of dust but only have maybe 1/4 gallon of dust in the collector bag. Very much worth the buy and saved alot from the super dust deputy so buy all the blast gates, pipe and hoses. Great for a small woodshop. Run it on a bandsaw, cabinet saw, jointer, belt sander, and lathe chute.
